auth.welcome: A diary for your cat's health, meals and mood

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a message to {{email}}. Follow the link in it to confirm your address. If you open it on another device, come back here after confirming and sign in.

validation.emailInvalid: That email address doesn't look right.
validation.passwordTooShort_one: Password must be at least {{count}} character.
validation.passwordTooShort_few: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordTooShort_many: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
validation.passwordTooShort_other: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.body: Enter the email you signed up with. We will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account with {{email}} exists, we sent it a message. Open the link in it on this device.

reset.title: New password
reset.body: Choose a new password for your account.

errors.expoGo: Google sign-in doesn't work in Expo Go — a development build is required.
errors.playServices: Update Google Play Services and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — follow the link in the message we sent.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Add letters, numbers or symbols.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look right.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the old one.
errors.generic: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.nameTooLong: Name must be at most {{count}} characters.
account.photoError: Couldn't upload the photo. Please try again.

home.emptyBody: Add your first cat to keep its diary: weight, meals, vaccinations.
home.comingSoon: Cat profiles are coming in the next update.

feed.emptyTitle: Your feed is empty for now

reminders.emptyBody: Food, meds, vaccinations, vet visits — we'll remind you on time, without spam.

deleteAccount.itemCats: the cats you added, with all their records and photos

deleteAccount.othersKeep: Records you made for other people's cats stay with them, without your name.
deleteAccount.noUndo: This can't be undone. If you want to keep your data, download it first.
deleteAccount.error: Couldn't delete your account. Check your connection and try again.
